name: Goldgorger
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #221: Into the Apocalypse Archive

generalAbilities.name: Rust Vision
generalAbilities.description: The goldgorger ignores the Concealed condition from rust clouds.

defensiveAbilities.name: Caustic Slivers
defensiveAbilities.description: 5 feet. The goldgorger continually leaks tiny fragments of partially digested gold into the air around it. Any creature that ends its turn in the aura takes 8d6 Acid Damage damage with a Basic DC 37 Reflex Saving Throw save. A creature that critically fails is also Sickened 1.

offensiveAbilities.name: Devour Metal
offensiveAbilities.description: Any time the goldgorger scores a critical hit with an adamantine bite attack, it deals the same amount of damage to any metal armor worn by the target, automatically bypassing any Hardness lower than 20. If a creature uses the Shield Block reaction with a metal shield against a goldgorger's adamantine bite, the shield is automatically broken, but no other item takes damage from that attack. Unattended metal items automatically take full damage from a goldgorger's adamantine bite, ignoring their Hardness if it's lower than 20.

offensiveAbilities.name: Searing Spew
offensiveAbilities.description: The goldgorger belches forth a cloud of caustic debris from its maw, filling a cube adjacent to it that's 10 feet on each side. Any creature in this area takes 6d10 Acid Damage|options:area-damage] damage (Basic DC 40 Reflex Saving Throw save). The ground under the cloud is difficult terrain for 1 hour, after which the shrapnel crumbles to dust. The goldgorger can't use Searing Spew again for 1d4 rounds, but the ability recharges if the goldgorger damages an item with devour metal.
